gap.title: The Education Gap
gap.body1: Uganda is home to nearly 2 million refugees, making it the largest refugee-hosting country in Africa. More than half are children who fled conflict in neighbouring countries, especially South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
gap.body2: Ayilo Refugee Settlement is home to more than **39,000 refugees**. **61%** of the settlement's population are school-age children. Existing schools struggle with overcrowding, shortages of qualified teachers, and limited learning materials, making it difficult for many children to access quality education.
